findings: AST successfully selected in one of two structural trials; neither simple trial used semantic tools.
LSP selected in both rename trials: one successful references request, two rename scope rejections, one rename call missing symbol/position.
Rename fixture has 42 TypeScript files, exceeding the existing 32-document scope bound.
The structural-task median was slower, so the predeclared per-task no-slower gate failed.
All 12 independent quality gates passed; no measured reliability superiority established.
disposition: Experimental candidate retained; v4 original checkout and installed app unchanged. Do not promote v5 on these measurements.
nextChanges: Keep AST optional when the required source context is already available.
Support larger bounded semantic scopes without reducing coverage or removing preimage/config guards.
Make conditional LSP arguments more discoverable and validate target identity before calling rename.
limitation: Two repetitions per task and arm; historical v4 run is not a matched policy ablation.
